name: same-backend-two-interfaces
description: Demonstrates the core claim of 'MCP vs API Explained': the same weather-lookup service function exposed both as a plain REST endpoint and as an MCP tool. MCP doesn't replace the API — it's a thin adapter in front of the exact same code path.

scripts.mcp:inspect: npm run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node dist/mcp/server.js
